relationships.subject: HLA-A
relationships.evidence_quote: The area of positive HLA-A signal in areas associated with TUJ1 staining was significantly correlated with symptoms of pain

relationships.subject: perineurial fibroblasts
relationships.evidence_quote: NGF signaling is also increased in painful samples where the main source is the perineural cluster

relationships.subject: macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: The macrophage cluster also expressed high levels of MMP9

relationships.subject: inflamed endothelial cells
relationships.evidence_quote: This cluster also displays downregulation of tight junction genes such as CLDN5

key_findings: Painful human lingual nerve neuromas show expanded proinflammatory endothelial cells and overexpression of HLA-A, CXCL2 and CXCL8.
HLA-A protein area correlated with pain VAS (r = 0.69); NGF signaling from perineurial cells increased in painful neuromas.
